name: VLM_benchmark_v2_cropped
description: A cropped-image version of a vision-language model (VLM) benchmark intended to evaluate VLMs on tasks where important visual context is partially occluded or cropped. It measures robustness and reasoning of VLMs across a variety of visual question and captioning tasks with reduced image context.
reputation: A community-contributed VLM evaluation suite used by VLM researchers for robustness checks; somewhat used but not a canonical benchmark.
